EQL log reader: ambiguous buff messages and healing

limitations: Log messages do not show your exact current or full health.
Starting a cast does not prove that the spell worked.
Spell countdowns use your saved durations, started by a matching landing message or by you. Unknown times stay unknown.
Critical hits count only when the damage line has a Critical tag. Missing tags do not prove a hit was normal.
Buff and debuff messages can be shared by several spells. Add only timer rules you have checked in game.
Healing shows the first amount in the log line. It may not equal the health you gained.
If spell damage cannot be sorted as direct damage or damage over time, its type stays unknown.
